newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa sees avg EPS growth above 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Axa sees avg EPS growth above 15 pct.

text.p: French insurer Axa said in a statement with first-half results it was aiming for average annual growth in earnings per share of more than 15 percent between 1995 and 2000.
It said its medium-term target was for a return on equity of 15 percent.

Axa said it would continue to pursue a rigorous underwriting strategy in non-life and reinsurance. The outlook was for further revenue and assets growth in life insurance, combined with "ongoing reductions in general expenses."
It expected satisfactory development of the recently launched life insurance activities in Japan and direct selling of non-life activities in France and Germany.
Axa earlier posted first-half net attributable profit of 1.98 billion francs, up from 1.3 billion.
